title: AxClass parsed metadata (NOT YET VALIDATED against full real file -- built from grep-confirmed facts only)

name.description: Class name from root <Name> (or <n> -- see tag_variance note on Method below).

extension_of.description: null for non-CoC classes (confirmed real case: RegNumCustTable_Extension, GeneralJournalAccountEntry_Extension -- both are 'public static class' with no ExtensionOf attribute at all). Populated only when a real [ExtensionOf(...)] attribute is found.

target_kind.description: Confirmed real target kinds seen across fixtures: classstr (SalesInvoiceDP), formStr (RealControlPrecisionInventTransForm), formdatasourcestr (SalesEditLines/SalesParmTable). tableStr not yet confirmed in fixtures -- still a gap per project notes.

target_name.description: The object being extended, e.g. 'SalesInvoiceDP'. For formdatasourcestr this may be a compound reference (form + datasource) -- needs confirming against real bytes, not yet done.

name.description: TAG VARIANCE WARNING (confirmed real case, GeneralJournalAccountEntry_Extension.xml): some AxClass exports use <Name>method</Name>, this file specifically used <n>... wait -- reversed from table methods. CONFIRM DIRECTION BEFORE TRUSTING: parser must check both <Name> and <n> under <Method> and not assume one. This was flagged from an earlier grep session, not from full-file inspection -- treat as unconfirmed until re-checked against real bytes.

calls_next.description: True if the method's <Source> CDATA text contains a bare 'next <methodName>(' call, per confirmed real cases (SalesInvoiceDP: 8 of 20 methods matched this pattern).

is_new_method.description: True if this method exists only in the extension (no next() call) -- i.e. a net-new method added by the CoC class rather than an override. Inferred as NOT calls_next -- this is an assumption, not yet confirmed against a real case where a method is verified to be genuinely new vs. an override that simply doesn't call next() (valid in real X++, e.g. a validateField override that fully replaces base logic).
